import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
months = sorted(grouped['month'].unique())
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for region, data in grouped.groupby('region'):
    data = data.sort_values('month')
    ax.plot(data['month'], data['revenue'], marker='o', label=region)
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_xticks(months)
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
